title: Request and Correlation Metadata
description: Observability identifiers carried across an interface boundary. These fields correlate work across services; they are never authorization inputs and carry no identity claims, credentials, or personal data. This schema is the single definition of identifier semantics: other contracts reference its $defs rather than restating patterns.

request_id.title: Request identifier
request_id.description: Identifies a single request at the boundary that received it. Generated by the receiving service, not accepted as an authorization token. Prefix 'req_' followed by 8 to 64 characters from [A-Za-z0-9_-].

correlation_id.title: Correlation identifier
correlation_id.description: Groups related requests and events belonging to one logical unit of work. Propagated unchanged across boundaries; a service that receives one reuses it rather than minting a new one. Prefix 'corr_' followed by 8 to 64 characters from [A-Za-z0-9_-].

traceparent.title: W3C traceparent
traceparent.description: W3C Trace Context traceparent header value, as defined by the W3C Trace Context Recommendation: version, trace-id, parent-id, and trace-flags separated by hyphens. Present only where trace context is propagated at the interface.

tracestate.title: W3C tracestate
tracestate.description: W3C Trace Context tracestate header value: vendor-specific trace continuation data as a comma-separated list of key-value pairs. Opaque to this contract.
